entities.name: UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure
entities.description: Procedure for a UE to request allocation of bearer resources for a traffic flow aggregate. The UE requests specific QoS demand (QCI) and optionally sends a GBR requirement.

entities.name: Dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure
entities.description: Procedure activated if the UE requested bearer resource allocation is accepted by the network.

entities.name: EPS bearer context modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure that may be invoked if the UE requested bearer resource allocation is accepted by the network.

entities.name: PDN connection for emergency bearer services established
entities.description: Condition where a PDN connection for emergency bearer services is established.

entities.name: UE shall not request additional bearer resources
entities.description: Behavior where the UE shall not request additional bearer resources for a PDN connection established for emergency bearer services.

relations.description: If accepted by the network, the UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure invokes the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure.
If accepted by the network, the UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure may invoke the EPS bearer context modification procedure.
If there is a PDN connection for emergency bearer services established, the UE shall not request additional bearer resources for this PDN connection.
